notes: The breadboard image is drawn with rows j-f in its upper half; the catalogue's bank 'b' holds rows f-j, so the upper half of the image is mapped to bank 'b' (e.g. 6b.i).
The bent (longer) LED leg is taken as the anode (A) at column 6. The straight leg is the cathode (C) at column 8.
The resistor is drawn in row h from column 3 to column 6. The orange wire is in column 3 row g, and the black GND wire is in column 8 row h.
The black wire goes to the GND pin next to pin 13 on the digital header. I mapped it to GND.1.
The manual says the resistor is 220 ohm, so value=220 is used.
